attchmntText: Kundan Minerals and Metals Limited has informed the Exchange about change in Management
voiceSummary: Kundan Minerals and Metals Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The Board appointed Ms. Preeti Yadav, ICSI Membership No. A82337, as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer effective 12 November 2026. For the half year ended 30 September 2026, the company reported a loss after tax of 374.25 lakhs, compared to a profit of 180.31 lakhs in the corresponding period of 2025. Revenue from operations stood at 507.03 lakhs. Total assets were 25815.26 lakhs as at 30 September 2026. Net cash used in operating activities was 11711.38 lakhs. Net cash generated from investing activities was 574.57 lakhs. Net cash generated from financing activities was 10956.83 lakhs. Cash and cash equivalents at the end of the period were 13.55 lakhs.

attchmntText: Kundan Minerals and Metals Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition
voiceSummary: Kundan Minerals and Metals Limited made an additional investment of Rs. 27,09,00,000 in its associate, Kundan Gold Mines Private Limited, through a rights issue. The equity shares were allotted on November 12th, 2026. The transaction is on an arm's length basis and does not change the company's 43.31% shareholding in the associate. The funds will support working capital and operational requirements. The associate operates in the mining sector and was incorporated on 05.07.2021. Its net worth as of March 31, 2026, was negative 224.21. Turnover for the last three financial years is reported as Nil. No governmental approvals were required.
